title: Pure Starry Knight
summary: Pure Starry Knight with Starry Night, Starry Dragon and Level 7 LIGHT Dragon partners, plus generic Rank 4 and Rank 7 Xyz Monsters and staples. The Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Starry Knights repeatedly bounce Level 7 LIGHT Dragons to the hand and Special Summon them again on either turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Starry Knight Rayel searches any Starry Knight Spell or Trap on Normal Summon, and banishes itself from the GY to revive a Starry Knight monster.

Starry Knight Balefire adds 1 Starry Knight monster or 1 Level 7 LIGHT Dragon from your Deck to your hand, and if you control no monsters while your opponent controls a DARK monster, also Special Summons a Level 7 LIGHT Dragon from your hand.
Starry Knight Orbitael tributes a LIGHT monster you control as a Quick Effect to Set a Starry Knight Spell or Trap directly from your Deck.
Starry Knight Ceremony reveals a Starry Knight in hand to add a Level 7 LIGHT Dragon from your Deck, or reveals a Level 7 LIGHT Dragon to search a Starry Knight.

summary.title: Opening: Starry Knight Rayel + Balefire
steps: Activate Starry Knight Balefire (or Starry Knight Ceremony) to add Starry Night, Starry Dragon to your hand.
Normal Summon Starry Knight Rayel to search Starry Knight Arrival (or Starry Knight Sky if you already have Arrival).
Set Starry Knight Arrival (and Starry Knight Blast if searched) to Special Summon Starry Night, Starry Dragon from your hand during the opponent's Main Phase and destroy a card on summon.

summary.title: Dragon Bounce & Summon Loop
summary.text: Starry Night, Starry Dragon targets and destroys 1 card on the field every time it is Normal or Special Summoned from the hand, cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects of DARK monsters, and banishes an attacked monster until the End Phase to make a second attack. Starry Knight Arrival, Starry Knight Ciel, Starry Knight Sky, and Starry Knight Blast return the Dragon from the field to your hand so you can Special Summon it from the hand again to pop another card.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Starry Night, Starry Dragon is the primary disruptive boss, backed up by Arkbrave Dragon (which banishes face-up opposing Spells/Traps when summoned from the GY) and Bahalutiya, the Grand Radiance (which forces the opponent to shuffle and redraw their hand when summoned from the hand).
Starring Knight is a Rank 4 LIGHT Fairy Xyz that detaches 1 material to Special Summon a LIGHT monster from your hand, and revives itself from the GY when a Level 7 LIGHT Dragon returns to your hand.
Two Level 7 Dragons on the field overlay into Rank 7 Number 11: Big Eye, Blaze, Supreme Ruler of all Dragons, or Voloferniges, the Darkest Dragon Doomrider.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Starry Knight Sky grants an extra Normal Summon of a Starry Knight or Level 7 LIGHT Dragon during your Main Phase, and draws 1 card whenever a face-up Level 7 LIGHT Dragon you control returns to the hand during your turn.
Starry Knight Arrival alternates between bouncing a Level 7 LIGHT Dragon you control to the hand and Special Summoning one from your hand during either Main Phase.
Starry Knight Blast returns a Level 7 LIGHT Dragon you control to the hand to negate and destroy any opposing card or effect activation.

allow.Starry Night, Starry Dragon: The Level 7 LIGHT Dragon the Starry Knight cards summon and return to the hand.
